title: The Belt Will Not Move
situation: After Alex restarts the machine, the belt does not move. The motor makes a low noise, and the indicator is yellow. Sam asks Alex to check the rollers from the outside, following the SOP. Alex finds a small object near a roller, clears it safely, and the belt moves again.
objective: Explain that a machine part will not move, describe a sound with the present continuous, say that something is missing with there is no and there isn't any, and report a safe visual check.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Hi, Sam. This is Alex. I restarted the machine, but the belt will not move.
dialogue.indonesian: Hai, Sam. Ini Alex. Saya sudah memulai ulang mesinnya, tetapi belt-nya tidak mau bergerak.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Okay. Is the motor making any noise?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Yes, the motor is making a low noise, but the belt is not moving.
dialogue.indonesian: Ya, motornya mengeluarkan suara rendah, tetapi belt-nya tidak bergerak.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Is the indicator on the control panel yellow?
dialogue.indonesian: Apakah indikator di panel kontrol berwarna kuning?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Yes, it is. The indicator is yellow, and there is no error message.
dialogue.indonesian: Ya. Indikatornya kuning, dan tidak ada pesan error.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Is the power switch still on?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Yes, it is. The PSU indicator is green too.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Good. Please check the rollers from the outside. Follow the official SOP and safety rules before you check the power or open any panel.
dialogue.indonesian: Bagus. Mohon periksa roller-nya dari luar. Ikuti SOP resmi dan aturan keselamatan sebelum memeriksa daya atau membuka panel apa pun.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Okay. I'm checking the rollers now.
dialogue.indonesian: Baik. Saya sedang memeriksa roller-nya sekarang.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: There is a small piece of plastic near the first roller.
dialogue.indonesian: Ada potongan plastik kecil di dekat roller pertama.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Thank you. Please follow the SOP and clear the area safely. Do not open the panel.
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih. Mohon ikuti SOP dan bersihkan area itu dengan aman. Jangan buka panelnya.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Understood. I followed the SOP and cleared the area. The roller is free now.
dialogue.indonesian: Dipahami. Saya sudah mengikuti SOP dan membersihkan area itu. Roller-nya sekarang bebas.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Good. Please restart the machine and tell me if the belt moves.
dialogue.indonesian: Bagus. Mohon mulai ulang mesinnya dan beri tahu saya apakah belt-nya bergerak.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: I restarted the machine. The belt is moving now, and the indicator is green.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya sudah memulai ulang mesinnya. Belt-nya sekarang bergerak, dan indikatornya hijau.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Excellent. Please run one test bag and check the output.
dialogue.indonesian: Bagus sekali. Mohon jalankan satu tas uji dan periksa output-nya.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: The test bag moved through the machine, and the output looks normal. I'll write the note. Thanks, Sam. Goodbye.
dialogue.indonesian: Tas uji itu bergerak melewati mesin, dan output-nya terlihat normal. Saya akan menulis catatannya. Terima kasih, Sam. Selamat tinggal.

keyExpressions.note: Will not + verb dasar menunjukkan bagian yang tidak berfungsi.

keyExpressions.english: The motor is making a low noise.
keyExpressions.note: Present continuous untuk bunyi yang sedang terjadi.
There is no + noun berarti tidak ada.

keyExpressions.english: Please check the rollers from the outside.
keyExpressions.note: From the outside berarti tanpa membuka panel.

sentencePatterns.explanation: Present continuous untuk bunyi atau gerakan yang sedang terjadi.
examples: The motor is making a low noise.
The belt is making a strange sound.

sentencePatterns.pattern: There is no + noun. / There isn't any + noun.
Please + verb + noun + from the outside.
examples: Please check the rollers from the outside.
Please look at the connector from the outside.

learningNotes: Gunakan will not + verb untuk bagian yang tidak mau bergerak atau bekerja.
There is no ... dan there isn't any ... sama-sama berarti 'tidak ada'.
Sebutkan hasil pemeriksaan secara singkat: The roller is free now.
Follow the official SOP and safety rules before checking power or opening panels.

pronunciationNotes.title: roller
pronunciationNotes.note: Tekanan di suku kata pertama: ROLL-er (/ˈroʊlər/).

pronunciationNotes.title: PSU
pronunciationNotes.note: Diucapkan per huruf: P-S-U (/ˌpiː ɛs ˈjuː/).
